metadata.question: Were the sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California on August 1, 2018 higher than the same region's sea surface temperature the year prior?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Terra Sea Surface Temperature (MODIS/061/MOD11A2) or use MODIS Ocean Color SST (MODIS/061/MOD28M). However, the latter is monthly; we need daily. MODIS/006/MYD28M is also monthly. Instead, we'll use MUR JPL SST (JPL/MUR/SST) which is 0.01° daily. - Date: 2018-08-01 vs 2017-08-01 - Location: La Jolla, California coastline → a point just offshore, e.g., -117.27, 32.85 2. Masking strategy: - MUR SST quality is good and no cloud mask needed; just ensure valid SST != 0 and not NaN. 3. Logic: - Pull one image per date: 2018-08-01 and 2017-08-01, both daytime - Extract SST at point - Compare: if 2018 > 2017 → A, else B - Handle C1: if no image on either date; C2: NaN at point; C3: None/NaN result ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85]) date18 = '2018-08-01' date17 = '2017-08-01' # 2. Data Acquisition (JPL MUR SST, daily, 1-km) sst18 = ee.ImageCollection('JPL/MUR/SST').filterDate(date18, date18).first() sst17 = ee.ImageCollection('JPL/MUR/SST').filterDate(date17, date17).first() # Check existence if (sst18 is None) or (sst17 is None): print("No SST image on 2017-08-01 or 2018-08-01.") print("C1") else: # 3. Extract SST (scale 0.001 converts to Kelvin) val18 = sst18.select('analysed_sst').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('analysed_sst').getInfo() val17 = sst17.select('analysed_sst').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('analysed_sst').getInfo() # 4. Validation if val18 is None or val17 is None: print("SST extraction failed.") print("C3") else: sst18_c = val18 * 0.001 - 273.15 sst17_c = val17 * 0.001 - 273.15 print(f"SST 2018: {sst18_c:.2f} °C, SST 2017: {sst17_c:.2f} °C") print("A" if sst18_c > sst17_c else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85])
date18 = '2018-08-01'
date17 = '2017-08-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition (JPL MUR SST, daily, 1-km)
sst18 = ee.ImageCollection('JPL/MUR/SST').filterDate(date18, date18).first()
sst17 = ee.ImageCollection('JPL/MUR/SST').filterDate(date17, date17).first()

# Check existence
if (sst18 is None) or (sst17 is None):
    print("No SST image on 2017-08-01 or 2018-08-01.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Extract SST (scale 0.001 converts to Kelvin)
    val18 = sst18.select('analysed_sst').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('analysed_sst').getInfo()
    val17 = sst17.select('analysed_sst').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('analysed_sst').getInfo()

    # 4. Validation
    if val18 is None or val17 is None:
        print("SST extraction failed.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        sst18_c = val18 * 0.001 - 273.15
        sst17_c = val17 * 0.001 - 273.15
        print(f"SST 2018: {sst18_c:.2f} °C, SST 2017: {sst17_c:.2f} °C")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if sst18_c > sst17_c else "<answer>B</answer>")
